checks.name: Task B: SRC_URL_RO read-only proof (Vercel Sandbox runner)
checks.expected: SHOW default_transaction_read_only reports 'on' over a session opened with $SRC_URL_RO, and a harmless write (BEGIN; CREATE TEMP TABLE _ro_probe(x int); ROLLBACK;) fails
checks.actual: `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 node scripts/migration/db/runner.mjs exec -- bash -lc 'psql "$SRC_URL_RO" -Atc "show default_transaction_read_only"'` did NOT connect at all: psql failed with `FATAL: unrecognized configuration parameter "+default_transaction_read_only"` (exit code 2), before any query ran. Root cause reproduced independently: readOnlyScopedUrl (scripts/migration/db/runner.mjs:123-134, specifically line 128 `u.searchParams.set("options", ...)`) builds SRC_URL_RO by setting the `options` query parameter via WHATWG URL/URLSearchParams, which percent-encodes the required space in `-c default_transaction_read_only=on` as `+` (application/x-www-form-urlencoded convention: confirmed by re-running the same `new URL(...).searchParams.set(...)` construction locally, producing `options=-c+default_transaction_read_only%3Don`). libpq's connection-URI parser only percent-decodes `%XX` sequences in query values and does not treat a literal `+` as a space, so the server receives the single malformed token `-c+default_transaction_read_only=on`/`+default_transaction_read_only` and rejects it outright at connection time. Net effect: SRC_URL_RO as currently constructed cannot open a session at all over psql/libpq -- it is not merely 'a default, not enforcement' (the P1.2 review's characterization); the read-only scoping is completely non-functional for any client that parses the URI the standard libpq way. This is the carry-forward nonBlocking finding in P1.2-harness-review.json (file: scripts/migration/db/runner.mjs, 'SRC_URL_RO relies on the startup parameter... no recorded proof that the Neon proxy honours it'), now confirmed to be worse than described. No connection string was printed; all output above was masked (://user:pass@ -> ://***:***@) before being surfaced.
